activation.note: Activation covers all embedded acceptances, including untouched ones, and retains the authored scan exclusions. Valid acceptances and empty WMBTs do not fire; file-kind classification and finding emission are honestly marked as requiring observers rather than inferred from the validator reference.

audit.summary: All 19 segments survive at their claimed destinations, collectively where multiple destinations are named. The single acceptance-shape obligation, proof rationale, example, scan exception and implementation metadata remain intact; the shared node contains only generic strict-disposition policy, and the two explicit elaborations are declared additions.

segmentChecks.note: The universal object-and-acc:-prefix requirement is explicit in then and verifier_detail[0]; given, avoid[2], and the activation notes also preserve coverage of untouched acceptances.

Package-rule context remains in verifier_detail[3], severity/strictness in verifier_detail[2], and the generic no-advisory consequence is appropriately represented by shared:policy.strict-disposition.
The package-gate scope, atdd-bun.* naming, and package-guard rather than canonical-planner-node implementation are retained verbatim in verifier_detail[3] and audit.
All four required per-rule checks—convention, strict, failing fixture, and relationship edges—remain in verifier_detail[3] and audit.
The why field preserves both that tests bind by the acc: identity and that an acceptance without it cannot be proven.
The exact identity: { urn: acc:<wagon>:<id> } repair pattern remains in prefer[0], with only a declared clarification of the placeholders.
All four excluded trees and the never-scanned rule are retained in unless[0], activation, and verifier_detail[1].
Strict disposition is stated in verifier_detail[2], and shared:policy.strict-disposition accurately adds that every finding fails with no advisory mode.
The exact validator type and planner_plan_integrity reference remain in audit, while evidence[0] and activation consistently describe the expected findings without inventing an existing observer.

unobservable: file_kind=wmbt requires a new observer to classify WMBT files.
The invalid-embedded-acceptance finding requires a new observer to parse WMBTs, enumerate all embedded acceptances, and test their object shape and identity.urn prefix.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the acceptance invariant, rationale, repair pattern, scan exclusions, package/strict metadata, and validator reference at their traced destinations. Its coder-facing decision is clear, but activation is not currently Datalog-executable until the explicitly identified file-kind and finding observers exist. I agree with the auditor's PASS verdict.
